item: row 267: law coverage report in Field data and read back
summary: 0.6 gate row C: the Field data button also saves /api/diagnostics/law-coverage (the Diagnostics zip's law-coverage.json; 37,397 bytes on the 140-country floor). scripts/law_coverage_readback.py (stdlib) reads it, a piece set or the zip and prints every floor country by state, the order and its source, the twelve-language tally with zh on its own line, many-country sources as counts, the world block and official counts. With the catalogue unreadable the states that need it read not looked up with the reason, never the report's zeros; codes, states, counts and dates only. Gate row C stays OPEN.
